title: Domestic freedom beyond separate searching

captions.energy: Seeking a way without shared discussion
captions.emotions: Feeling attachment to familiar material support

meaning: Your domestic support becomes freer when private reflection on a habit gains shared expression instead of attachment leaving every binding action beyond reconsideration.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Hermit in energy complicates them through separate searching for an answer. The Devil in emotions feels attachment to material support. The repeated card distinguishes action from experience. Both can notice inconvenience but keep storing and maintaining the familiar because release seems lost sufficiency. Silent consideration changes no conditions while the question remains outside accessible shared conversation.

For example, numerous rarely used kitchen appliances remain. One privately seeks an ideal storage system while release feels difficult to both because each object promises necessary convenience. **Private searching does not free life when the binding promise itself cannot be named together.** Actual use and present cost can be discussed. Choice returns to both instead of remaining one person’s inward task supposedly requiring preservation of everything familiar while removing every inconvenient consequence.

The difficulty is awaiting an answer in which nobody loses anything. Objects remain while private reflection prolongs habitual maintenance. Distinguishing usefulness from untouchability offers more dependable support: a past wish does not require eternal continuation. Support grows through naming attachment without judgement and choosing enough under present conditions instead of making one ideal system decide the entire question of shared domestic freedom for both. Reflection can help once its subject becomes accessible.
